todos.title: Testing stops after returning from sub-container
todos.description: When using STCheck::debug('test') with nested containers (e.g., bill -> Order), testing completes the sub-container but stops instead of continuing with remaining tables in the parent container

analysis.expectedBehavior: After testing all tables in Order container, should return to bill container and test remaining tables (Article, addressee container)
analysis.actualBehavior: Test stops after completing Order container tables (order, article)
analysis.rootCause: When returning from sub-container, step was set to 10 (delete done), but the condition at line 1138 only checks for step 0 or 11 to trigger makeNextTableContainer_Test(). Step 10 fell through to makeTableListing_Test() which cannot handle it properly.
analysis.fix: Changed step from 10 to 11 when returning from sub-container. Step 11 means 'go to table listing for next table' which correctly triggers makeNextTableContainer_Test() to find the next untested table.

stepsToReproduce: 2. Run the test - bill container has namedLink to Order container
3. Test completes bill table, jumps into Order container
4. Tests order and article tables in Order container
5. Should return to bill and test Article + addressee, but stops
todos.resolution: Fixed by changing testdebug['step']= 10 to testdebug['step']= 11 at lines 1194, 1201, 1524, 1532

todos.title: Test report shows tables only with test.see debug mode
todos.description: With debug('test') alone, successful table tests are not written to selftable_test_report.txt

analysis.codeSnippet: if(!STCheck::isDebug('test.see')) return ''; // should not write anything into report
analysis.explanation: This is intentional - only errors are logged by default. Use debug('test.see') to see all pages

todos.resolution: This is working as designed. Documentation should clarify the difference between 'test' and 'test.see' modes

todos.title: Add summary statistics to test report
todos.description: The test report should include a summary at the end showing total tables tested, errors found, time per table, etc.

todos.title: Testing does not navigate to needContainer sub-containers when no Article table in main container
todos.description: When the main bill ObjectContainer does not have an Article table defined directly (line 34 commented out in 04_basic_main.php), after returning from the Order sub-container the test cannot find the addressee container. The variable $sorted_selftable_test_links['container']['###link'] has no container entries because the STChooseBox only registers container buttons when they appear in the choose menu listing, and after returning from a namedLink sub-container the choose menu may not include them.

analysis.expectedBehavior: After finishing article table in Order container, testing should return to bill container and continue to addressee container, then test Person table
analysis.actualBehavior: Testing stops after Order container because $sorted_selftable_test_links['container']['###link'] is not populated when Article table is not in the main container - the test has no link to navigate to the addressee container
analysis.rootCause: Two issues: (1) The 'new next table' section at line 1174 fires even when makeNextTableContainer_Test() already set link-type to 'container_link', causing incorrect state override. (2) When no more table-buttons are found in makeNextTableContainer_Test(), the code did not attempt to navigate to remaining sub-containers via container['###link'] entries.
analysis.fix: Added guard condition to skip 'new next table' section when link-type is already 'container_link'. Added isset() check for $sorted_selftable_test_links['container']['###link'] before accessing it. Added container navigation branch in makeNextTableContainer_Test() to enter remaining sub-containers when no more tables are found but containers exist.

stepsToReproduce: 3. Run the test - bill container still has namedLink to Order container and needContainer($addressee)
4. Test completes bill table, jumps into Order container via namedLink
5. Tests order and article tables in Order container
6. Returns to bill but cannot find addressee container to test Person table
todos.resolution: Three changes in STSiteCreator.php: (1) Guard 'new next table' section with link-type != 'container_link' check at line 1174. (2) Added isset($sorted_selftable_test_links['container']['###link']) check at line 1183. (3) Added container navigation branch in makeNextTableContainer_Test() at line 1563 to enter sub-containers when all tables are tested but containers remain.
